statement.zh: 若将努兹直接并入「第三千纪南部城市革命」同一叙事，易混淆第二千纪北两河档案城镇与乌鲁克—早王朝南部城市轨迹。
statement.en: Folding Nuzi directly into the same narrative as the southern third-millennium urban revolution risks conflating a second-millennium northern archive-town with the Uruk–ED southern trajectory.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: chronological and regional mismatch; Starr documents Nuzi as excavated, not as an Early Dynastic southern city.

editorial.notes: Density pass 4; contested material kept as hypothesis where applicable.
